div.div:
Drain loop
Polls the convmem and cv-chat queues in strict
ALTERNATION, not tokio::select!. select! drops the
losing future after SQS may already have made its
messages invisible — a five-minute stall per record.

div.div:
Two independent gates, both required for /cvchat/*:
① mTLS client certificate, enforced by nginx on Leia
② Cognito access token, validated by Cal itself
Visitor IP, user agent and message text are age-encrypted
before they leave AWS. Only an opaque id travels in clear.
